about: Hand-kept part of docs/games/support.md (engine games support, tools/game_support.ps1): categories, bind files, command-list sources, anti-cheat, in-game test results, open points, the documented-only titles and the reasons for partial cells. The marks come from the code; a cell here may only lower a mark (with a note). Test levels: e2e (a green in-game run), partial (in game, not green or not complete), files (checked against installed game files only), blind (not installed), none (documented only).

categories.title: Flight simulators
categories.note: Civil and general flight simulators. JoyPro takes over the devices it writes (clean and nuke clear every other bind of those devices).

categories.title: Combat flight
categories.note: Combat flight sims and combat flight games that read several joysticks.

categories.title: Space
categories.note: Space sims: clean and nuke touch only the cataloged ship actions, on-foot and vehicle binds stay.

categories.title: Military sims
categories.note: Infantry sims with aircraft and helicopters: JoyPro writes only the cataloged aircraft and helicopter actions.

categories.title: Arcade and one-device games
categories.note: Arcade flight games and shooters that read one joystick, only Xbox pads, or a fixed layout (docs: one-device-games.md).
